name: branding-navy-and-copper-real-estate-guidelines-cover
title: Navy brand-guidelines cover with orange house-N logo and a giant copper-brown fragment

whatItMeans: Professional and grounded; a giant cropped logo detail adds confidence.

Use an orange rule under the title.
Combine navy with copper and orange.
Keep small credits at the bottom.
